faq.question: How much does window replacement cost in Hercules?
faq.answer: Hercules homeowners typically invest $4,500 to $10,000 for a full window replacement project. This planned Contra Costa community features 1970s–1990s homes with standard window sizing that makes replacement efficient and cost-effective. Projects covering 10–15 windows are typical. Single window installation starts at approximately $440.

faq.question: Do I need a permit to replace windows in Hercules?
faq.answer: Yes. Hercules requires a building permit for window replacements. Our team handles all permit applications with the City of Hercules Building Department on your behalf.

faq.question: Is it worth replacing 20-year-old windows in Hercules?
faq.answer: Often yes. Twenty-year-old windows in Hercules commonly show fogged glass, drafts and weak locks. Newer ENERGY STAR units improve comfort and curb appeal; Deluxe Windows compares payback against your utility rates and home style before recommending replacement.

faq.question: Should I choose fiberglass or vinyl windows in Hercules?
faq.answer: Vinyl is the value pick for most Hercules replacements and handles Bay Area weather well. Fiberglass (including Marvin Ultrex) is stronger, more stable in temperature swings and better for larger openings or coastal exposure. We show both side by side in the showroom and on-site.

faq.question: How long does window replacement take in Hercules?
faq.answer: Most Hercules projects are measured in one visit and installed in one to three working days once products arrive — typically four to eight weeks after ordering, depending on brand and custom sizes.
